entries.text: 這就是藍莓學園\n獨步全世界的海中庭園……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_01

entries.text: 雖然是位在海裡，\n但因為牆壁和圓頂上都有投影，\r\n所以就像是在戶外，對吧！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_03

entries.text: 這裡人工創造出了\n適合寶可夢棲息的環境。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_04

entries.text: 是我設計的喔～！\n可是砸了大把大把的錢啊～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_01

entries.text: 巨蛋裡包含了\n４個環境區域……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_05

entries.text: 首先是這裡，\n充滿亞～熱帶風情的草原區。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_06

entries.text: 正面右手邊是\n南～國氣氛十足的海岸區。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_07

entries.text: 左邊是\n能看到溪～谷景色的峽谷區。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_08

entries.text: 最後，最裡面的是\n擁有雪～國風景的極地區。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_09

entries.text: 每個區域的氣溫和濕度等等，\n都經過細微的調整。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_10

entries.text: 所以只要區域不同，\n棲息的寶可夢也截然不同喔！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_11

entries.text: 這可是我費盡心思講究的啊～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_02

entries.text: 亞熱帶的草原區
entries.label: sdc02_0060_select_01

entries.text: 南國的海岸區
entries.label: sdc02_0060_select_02

entries.text: 溪谷的峽谷區
entries.label: sdc02_0060_select_03

entries.text: 雪國的極地區
entries.label: sdc02_0060_select_04

entries.text: 畢竟草原是最經典的。\c\n這一區的視野很好，\n所以也很容易觀察寶可夢的生態！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_13

entries.text: 呵呵，看來我們合得來！\n我也最喜歡那裡了！\r\n悠～閒的氣氛讓人心平氣和！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_14

entries.text: 原來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳喜歡稜稜角角的。\c\n峽谷區還有一種叫做電氣石的\n神奇礦石喔！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_15

entries.text: 原來[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳喜歡寒冷的地方呀！\c\n雖然我怕冷，\n但冰屬性寶可夢很可愛！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_16

entries.text: 想幫寶可夢回復時，\n歡迎自由使用設置在巨蛋裡的\r\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]自助回復機[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_17

entries.text: 那麼，席藍校長。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_18

entries.text: 為什麼在藍莓學園裡\n野生的寶可夢會太晶化，\r\n還會有結晶生成呢？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_19

entries.text: 咦？妳不是知道嗎？\n……哦，原來是要這樣進行啊。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_03

entries.text: 欲知答案……\n請看圓頂！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_04

entries.text: 那正是守護著生態巨蛋的\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]生態核[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_05

entries.text: 那裡頭裝著的液體中，\n溶有在帕底亞採集的某種物質喔～[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_06

entries.text: 因為從那裡會\n照射出太晶的能量，\r\n所以巨蛋裡的太晶元素很活潑！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_07

entries.text: 好厲害～！太～神奇了！\n原來如此！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_20

entries.text: 這麼說起來，\n生態核裡面的物質是什麼呢？\r\n這個資訊……沒有公開吧？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_21

entries.text: 呵呵呵，那個嘛～……[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_08

entries.text: ……咦？是什麼來著？[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_09

entries.text: 這件事全交給了白蕾雅負責，\n我不太清楚呢。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_16

entries.text: 鈴　啷　噹　啷～♪
entries.label: sdc02_0060_system_01

entries.text: 實習課即將在\n海岸區開始。
entries.label: sdc02_0060__announcement_01

entries.text: 要參加的學生\n請到海岸區集合。
entries.label: sdc02_0060__announcement_02

entries.text: 啷　鈴　啷　噹～♪
entries.label: sdc02_0060_system_02

entries.text: 正好要開始上課了呢！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_23

entries.text: 機會難得，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n我們一起去上[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳在本校的第一堂課吧？[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_24

entries.text: 呵呵呵，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳真是熱心學習！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_25

entries.text: [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳不喜歡學習嗎？\n這是個難得的機會呢……走吧！！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_26

entries.text: 我幫[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳把巨蛋內的地圖\n登錄到手機洛托姆。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_27

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]的地圖App中\n追加了[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]生態巨蛋地圖[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: sdc02_0060_system_03

entries.text: 生態巨蛋要\n自己走一走才有趣，\r\n要是由我帶路說不定反而礙事……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_28

entries.text: ……嗯！所以呢，\n到海岸區上課地點的這段路，\r\n就請[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳用自己的雙腳前往吧！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_29

entries.text: 看來就算我不在，\n也完全沒問題了。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_10

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n我們也幫[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳準備了宿舍的房間。\r\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳之後可以去看看！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_11

entries.text: 啊～還有，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳打開圖鑑App一下。[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_13

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]的寶可夢圖鑑中\n追加了[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]藍莓圖鑑[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]！
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_15

entries.text: 生態巨蛋裡的寶可夢\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳可以隨心所欲捉個夠喔！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_14

entries.text: 那麼，盡情享受在\n藍莓學園的生活吧～！[VAR 0x0114(004B)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_headbb_12

entries.text: 他真的就這麼走了……[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_31

entries.text: 我會好好照顧[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的，\n[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳不用擔心喔。[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_32

entries.text: 去上課咯！\n我會在海岸區等[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]你妳的！[VAR 0x0114(0049)]
entries.label: sdc02_0060_fairybb_33
